**Starts** once #53 and #65 are merged.

## Why

These tests check, with the real agent, what the functional spec's acceptance scenarios describe, and the memory rules, such as no leak between users. As evaluations, they can be rerun after any change to the instructions, the tools, or the model (#53).

## Design

- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), section 11.
- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 3.1 (tests).

## Open questions

1. Should the memory tests also check the forgotten line? When the user forgets a memory item in the chat view's memory list, the app adds a line to the next message telling the coordinator to read memory again and stop using any item that's gone ([technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 5.2). A test would have the coordinator read memory, forget an item through the list, send a message, and check that the coordinator reads memory again and doesn't use the item. Added from #131.

## Do

- Add real-agent tests for acceptance scenarios S1 to S13, and the three memory tests in technical spec section 3.1, as evaluations in the setup from #53.

## Done when

- Each test passes, and the results are in the PR.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-36-acceptance-scenarios-and-memory-tests).
